integrity.scientific_basis: Explicit variable-threshold CW quotient and null higher attaching-map proof; 470 independent finite checks for t>=5, plus 205 checks of the previously known t=4 boundary, are supplementary.
integrity.source_date_basis: Earliest verified public preprint timestamp for the motivating source, 2026-02-10 (arXiv:2602.09623).

limitations: The graph H is finite, nonempty and triangle-free; the new theorem covers t>=5. The t=4 case was published previously and is not claimed as original.
The equivalence is nonequivariant and does not classify graph automorphism actions.
The finite checker uses F2 homology and is not evidence for the integral infinite theorem; the integral assertion follows from the provided proof.
An equivalent result in unindexed or inaccessible literature may exist.
title: A uniform higher-clique-free homotopy transfer for joins with triangle-free graphs
